digest.component_or_area: rebar._store.push — CAS delivery and workflow entrypoints
propositions: Duplicate fetch-merge-retry CAS loops in workflows must be consolidated into a single Python core module.
The Python push core owns the five-cycle retry budget, fetch-and-merge recovery, and terminal push decision, exposing strict and best-effort delivery modes.
Workflow adapters delegate outbound tickets-branch delivery exactly once through Python entrypoints instead of implementing their own retry loops.
Strict delivery mode raises typed PushDeliveryError with operational detail and unpushed-commit count; best-effort legacy callers retain silent default behavior.
The locked commit-and-push entrypoint stages, commits, and pushes the workflow transaction with configurable author and subject in a single atomic operation.
